subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared agent-facing inbound attachment metadata contract, or keep Slack attachments represented only through placeholders and media path/type fields for now?
rationale: The remaining gap is clear in current source, but the durable fix changes an agent-facing channel/plugin context shape and should be chosen deliberately across Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channels.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add an InboundAttachments-style field across the shared inbound channel contract while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack file metadata is available only through fileId-bearing placeholders plus downloaded media references and close or defer structured metadata.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Metadata
options.body: Add a narrow Slack field first, accepting later migration risk if other channels need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add an InboundAttachments-style field across the shared inbound channel contract while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared media contract blame and issue discussion both point to Vincent Koc as the best available owner for the API-shape choice.
